verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-data API service, not an agent, so an official MCP server applies. It documents an install-MCP guide for connecting AI clients to Context.dev tools, and a probe confirms an official MCP endpoint at mcp.context.dev/mcp. Missing for 10: a detailed tool list and per-client setup steps in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your AI client to Context.dev tools for live web and company data.
official MCP server documented at https://mcp.context.dev/mcp
